title: Campus Dining Planner — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Plans meals around campus dining halls, hours, and options. The Campus Dining Planner helps plan meals around campus dining options. It knows each dining hall's hours, menus, and dietary options, matches meals to the student's class schedule and meal plan swipes, and suggests where to eat between classes. Dietary needs — vegetarian, halal, allergies — filter the options.
capabilities: Know dining hall hours and menus
Match meals to class schedules
Track meal-plan swipes and balance
Filter by dietary needs and allergies
Suggest the best hall between classes
